target.artifact: recovery successor cas guard live recovery attempt receipts
target.consumer: universal worker allocator / stale recovery / stress verifier
target.scope: one live recovery successor per opportunity_id previous_run

canonical_identity.problem: same opportunity and same previous_run can currently have multiple distinct recover runs in started state under separate recovery claims so exclusivity of the recovery successor is not durably proven and duplicate scoped work can distort recovery latency and collision metrics
acceptance: a losing concurrent recoverer persists an append only recovery attempt receipt resolving the winning recovery claim and does not enter started
a two recoverer live canary proves exactly one started successor and one lost_existing outcome and an independent verifier reconciles both outcomes
late original and losing recovery evidence remain immutable candidate evidence and no recovery path overwrites prior attempts
recovery claim key is deterministically scoped to opportunity_id plus previous_run and enforced with create if absent exclusivity before started
